description: Requires a free Messe Atlas account (sign in when prompted). Convention-bureau and tourism-board support schemes for an exhibition, conference, meeting or incentive (optionally in one country). Each active scheme is screened against its published criteria: `match` is `likely` (every published criterion supplied and met) or `check` (something is unknown, late or stale), with the reasons; schemes that do not appear to fit are listed under `not_matched` with the reason. Returns benefits and amounts as published, `url`, `apply_url`, `as_of` and `stale`. Not advice: confirm eligibility, amounts and deadlines with the body.

international_pct.description: Expected share of international participants, in percent.

start_date.description: Event start (YYYY-MM-DD), to screen application lead times.
